review.notes: Reviewed all 48 timed frames in four directions before and after exact PixelLab cleanup. Stabilized changing glasses, face and hair details, held planted idle shoes steady and repeated the initial rest pose at each idle seam. Original vertical head motion is retained. South jaw edits exclude the surrounding shoulder poses. Every walking pixel from row 45 down is unchanged, preserving the generated arms, cuffs, apron, legs and shoes. All silhouettes remain connected and registered on the shared foot line. Minor cuff, hand and apron-shape variation remains. Suggested entry poses and a 120 ms settling hold control playback; these are not separate generated transition clips. The furnished laboratory is a staged visual test without collision, navigation or prop interactions. Live browser rendering has not been verified.
